description: Eight independent character records cover active u8, main status u32, HP u32, six maximum and six current SP u32. Signed negative recovery sums maxima modulo 2^32. Child 52b910 and notification functions execute unchanged. All character names, slot notification selectors, and the suffix are zero initialized; the synthetic UTF-16 :%u format consumes the actual recovery count. For this empty-name and empty-suffix fixture, wcslen returns zero and wcscat has no memory effect, via case-local import stubs. Renderer absent and notification mode zero, as in 0052b910. No original executable bytes or tables are embedded.
